Snapshot bytes were compared with the local capture where both exist.

pinned_elsewhere.note: Captured by milestone 1 (weights17_manifest.json). Its Internet Archive digest (20190615183854) equals the current bytes, so the construction report has not changed since at least June 2019. PDF p. 3 and p. 9: the 2017 New Immigrant sample is not covered and its weighting methodology 'will be available from the PSID website'.

Retrieved by milestone 1 from the official URL at 2026-09-28T17:41:53Z (weights23_manifest.json); report dated June 2026. What it documents about 2017: PDF p. 2 notes 2-3 (calibration to ACS estimates since 2015; the 2017 new immigrant sample has zero longitudinal family weight in 2017); p. 3 (the 2017 Immigrant sample; Chang et al. (2021), the 2019 longitudinal report, for its recruitment); p. 6 (a different approach to selecting calibration variables since 2017); p. 13 Table A2 (the 2017 sum of individual weights beside the ACS one-year PUMS population total, CPS 'Not Used'; donut-hole families and group-quarters post-1997 immigrants 'were excluded from the ACS estimate in 2017'); p. 14 Table A3 (2017 individual weight ER34651). The 2017 base weights and raking dimensions are not documented.
